title: Backstop Issue Schema v1
description: Schema for issues — lightweight sister artifact to specs with full traceability parity. Supports bug fixes, enhancements, and technical debt tracking. Requirements and claims validated on close. Extends backstop-artifact-base-v1.

requirements.description: REQ-NNN requirements — full parity with specs. Optional 'supports' traces back to bundle requirement (format: bundle-name:REQ-NNN). Required when status is 'closed'.

claims.description: CLM-NNN claims — full parity with specs. Each claim traces to a REQ-NNN and mandates test names. Required when status is 'closed'.

contracts.description: API surface contracts — provides/consumes declarations. Required from 'ready' onward.

enforcement.blocked-requires-blocked-by: Issues with status 'blocked' must have non-empty context.blocked_by array
enforcement.closed-requires-date: Issues with status 'closed' must have issue.closed date
enforcement.closed-requires-traceability: Requirements and claims arrays required and fully validated from 'ready' onward — every REQ must have ≥1 CLM, every CLM must reference a valid REQ
enforcement.id-filename-consistency: issue.id must match the ISSUE-NNN prefix in the filename
enforcement.supports-traceability: Optional 'supports' field on requirements traces back to bundle-name:REQ-NNN
